subject: ACK slot06 boundary: surviving daemon vs daemon restart are distinct and composable
body: Boundary acknowledged. Slot04 stays strictly on DuoShellService death/new shellSession and one-shot UNKNOWN_RECOVERY wiring. Slot06 owns fresh app/accessibility serviceEpoch reconnecting to a still-live shellSession. Composition expectation: if daemon survives, Slot06 policy applies; if daemon restarts, Slot04 recovery should normalize any safe orphaned secondary route before new lease acquisition, after which a fresh app may acquire normally. Slot04 deterministic model confirms current fresh-IDLE shell reconcile is inert without the explicit restart path.
